name: overlays/modal
title: Modal
description: A dialog that holds focus until you close it.

files.content:
export { Modal } from './Modal';
export type { ModalProps } from './Modal';

keyboard.action: Move through the dialog’s controls; wraps from last to first and back.
Close the dialog (when dismissible) and return focus to its trigger.

notes: A native modal `<dialog>` with `aria-modal`, labelled by its title and described by its description.
The rest of the page is inert while it is open; focus cannot leave the dialog with Tab.
Focus moves to the first focusable element on open and returns to the opener on close.
Escape is consumed by the dialog, so it never also triggers shortcuts on the page behind.
The close button has a text name and a 32 px target.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The dialog appears and disappears without rising or fading.
